facts.content: Patient has had watery diarrhea 5-6 times a day for 3 days.
The diarrhea began with brief vomiting which has resolved.
No blood in stools, no abdominal pain reported.
Patient has poor appetite and tolerates minimal solids.
Patient felt febrile initially but is afebrile now.
Patient has a history of asthma.
Patient uses Salbutamol (blue) inhaler as needed.
Father had hypertension and died of bowel cancer.
Patient lives alone and is a software engineer.
Patient is a non-smoker and occasionally consumes alcohol socially.
Oral rehydration salts like Dioralyte and increase fluid intake advised.
facts.source_text: Oral rehydration salts (e.g., Dioralyte); push fluids

facts.content: Paracetamol advised as needed for fever or malaise.
Patient advised to rest and stay off work until diarrhea-free for at least 24-48 hours.
facts.source_text: Rest; off work until diarrhea-free ≥24–48 h

facts.content: Return or seek care if symptoms persist over 5 days, worsen, or red flags like fever, blood in stool, persistent vomiting appear.
facts.source_text: Return/seek care if symptoms persist >5 d, worsen, or red flags (fever, blood in stool, persistent vomiting)
